title: Options Market-Making Lab
summary: An educational Python simulator for exploring options pricing, discrete hedging, and inventory risk.
question: What changes when an options hedge can only be adjusted at discrete times and every adjustment has a cost?

figure.alt: Simulated fees of $0.016 for 12 hedge adjustments, $0.034 for 52, and $0.065 for 252.
figure.caption: Fees from the lab’s seeded six-month call example. The bars show costs for the simulated schedules.

symbol.name: delta
symbol.meaning: how much an option’s price moves with the stock, and the quantity the hedge tracks.

sections.title: What’s in the simulator
sections.text: The lab includes European option prices from Black–Scholes, a binomial tree, and seeded Monte Carlo. It also simulates discrete delta hedges and inventory-aware quotes under stylized order flow, with separate accounting for sources of profit and loss.

sections.title: What it can illustrate
sections.text: The setup makes it possible to hold a price path fixed and compare hedge frequency or compare quotes while holding the order-flow seed fixed. These are controlled scenarios built on idealized prices and fills.
